2b7e222888.q: How much did P3 Adaptive save by rebuilding its website internally instead of outsourcing?
2b7e222888.a: P3 Adaptive saved approximately one million dollars by rebuilding their website internally using AI rather than outsourcing. Rob Collie is confident they couldn't have gotten a site of comparable quality for anything less than a million dollars if they had outsourced it. They had priced out an outsourced rebuild in 2024 at $300,000, but after seeing the mock-ups decided to pass, knowing that getting from good to great through an outsourced process typically runs three to four times the original quote in time and money.

9487e16656.q: What is the 'Build in Plain Sight' methodology that P3 Adaptive used for their website project?
9487e16656.a: Build in Plain Sight is P3 Adaptive's iterative development approach where everyone involved can constantly see the current state of the project and the latest changes, and iterate and sometimes argue from there. This methodology contrasts with outsourced projects that typically follow a 'ta-da moment' approach with one big reveal at the end. The approach yields far better results because at every touchpoint, stakeholders can see it, shape it, and improve it.
